items.title: Revisiting somatosensory evoked potentials in motor neuron diseases: neurophysiological insights from a large cohort.
items.summary: To systematically investigate Somatosensory Evoked Potential (SEP) abnormalities in a large cohort of patients with Motor Neuron Disease (MND), and to explore their relationship with Motor Evoked Potentials (MEPs) and clinical phenotypes. We retrospectively analyzed 267 patients with confirmed MND who underwent standardized SEPs and transcranial magnetic stimulation. Patients were divided into pure/predominant Upper Motor Neuron (UMN) and pure/predominant Lower Motor Neuron/Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (LMN/ALS) groups. SEP abnormalities were assessed using internal normative data, including prolonged latencies, reduced amplitudes, and increased N20-P25 amplitudes. MEPs were classified semi-quantitatively as normal or abnormal by independent raters. At least one SEP abnormality was detected in 75 % of patients, with no significant differences between the UMN and LMN/ALS groups. Increased N20-P25 amplitudes were observed in both phenotypes, suggesting widespread sensory cortical hyperexcitability across the MND spectrum. In contrast, abnormal MEPs were significantly more frequent in UMN patients (p < 0.001). No significant association was found between SEP abnormalities and MEP findings. Upper- and lower-limb SEP latencies were strongly correlated (all p < 0.001), whereas increased SEP amplitudes did not correlate with latency abnormalities. SEP abnormalities are highly prevalent in MND and appear largely independent from corticospinal dysfunction. Increased SEP amplitudes likely reflect primary cortical sensory hyperexcitability rather than impaired sensory conduction. These findings support the concept of MND as a multisystem network disorder that involves sensory cortical circuits and highlight the role of SEPs in the diagnostic workup.
items.titleZh: 重新审视运动神经元病中的体感诱发电位：来自大型队列的神经生理学见解
items.summaryZh: 这项针对267名运动神经元病患者的大型回顾性研究发现，75%的患者存在体感诱发电位异常，且在上运动神经元为主和ALS/下运动神经元为主两组中发生率相似。值得注意的是，N20-P25波幅增高在两种表型中均常见，提示感觉皮层过度兴奋是MND的普遍特征，且与运动通路功能障碍相对独立。
items.insight: 该研究为MND不仅是运动系统疾病、而是涉及感觉皮层的多系统网络疾病提供了大型队列的神经电生理证据，提示SEP可能作为评估疾病皮层过度兴奋状态的辅助工具，值得ALS研究者关注其在疾病机制和潜在生物标志物方面的价值。

aiRead.limitation: 回顾性设计，缺乏健康对照组（使用内部规范数据），MEP分类为半定量，未提供纵向随访数据。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在系统性地调查运动神经元病（MND）患者队列中体感诱发电位（SEP）的异常情况，并探讨其与运动诱发电位（MEP）及临床表型的关系。研究者回顾性分析了267例确诊MND并接受标准化SEP和经颅磁刺激检查的患者。患者被分为纯/主要上运动神经元（UMN）组和纯/主要下运动神经元/肌萎缩侧索硬化（LMN/ALS）组。SEP异常通过内部规范数据进行评估，包括潜伏期延长、波幅降低和N20-P25波幅增高。MEP由独立评估者半定量分类为正常或异常。结果显示，75%的患者至少存在一项SEP异常，UMN组与LMN/ALS组之间无显著差异。两种表型均观察到N20-P25波幅增高，提示MND谱系中存在广泛的躯体感觉皮层过度兴奋。相比之下，异常MEP在UMN患者中显著更常见（p < 0.001）。SEP异常与MEP结果之间未发现显著关联。上下肢SEP潜伏期强相关（均p < 0.001），而SEP波幅增高与潜伏期异常无相关性。SEP异常在MND中高度普遍，且在很大程度上独立于皮质脊髓功能障碍。SEP波幅增高可能反映原发性皮层感觉过度兴奋，而非感觉传导受损。这些发现支持MND是一种涉及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病的概念，并强调SEP在诊断评估中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的大型队列数据，揭示了MND中感觉皮层过度兴奋与运动通路功能障碍的独立性，为ALS作为多系统网络疾病的转化概念提供了新近的神经生理学证据。

items.title: Chronic neurological diseases with acute respiratory failure in a real-life cohort: insights into ICU and long-term survival-A retrospective study.
items.summary: Patients with chronic neurological diseases (CND) are at increased risk of pulmonary complications that often require ICU admission. This study aimed to identify clinical factors associated with ICU mortality and long-term survival in patients with CND who developed acute respiratory failure (ARF). This retrospective cohort study was conducted in a level III respiratory ICU. Patients with pre-existing CND admitted to the ICU with ARF were included. ICU mortality was analyzed using multivariable logistic regression. Long-term survival after ICU discharge was evaluated using Kaplan-Meier survival analysis and Cox proportional hazards models. Mortality timing was further characterized using hazard function analysis. A total of 220 patients were included; the most common neurological diagnoses were dementia (37.3%), stroke (22.7%), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (14.1%). ICU mortality was 33.6%. Higher APACHE II scores were independently associated with increased ICU mortality (OR 1.076 per point increase; 95% CI 1.029-1.126; p < 0.001). Long-term survival differed significantly by post-discharge respiratory support strategy, with Kaplan-Meier analysis demonstrating more favorable survival patterns among patients receiving home non-invasive mechanical ventilation (NIMV) (p = 0.003). In Cox regression analysis, age, home NIMV, and feeding modality at discharge were independently associated with long-term outcomes. Survival analyses revealed an early clustering of deaths within the first months after ICU discharge, particularly among patients with dementia. In patients with CND, acute physiological severity was the main determinant of ICU mortality, whereas long-term survival after ICU discharge was poor, with deaths clustering within the first months thereafter. Post-discharge respiratory support and nutritional management should be individualized according to the expected clinical trajectory and patient values.
items.titleZh: 真实队列中慢性神经系统疾病伴急性呼吸衰竭：ICU及长期生存的见解——一项回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了220例因急性呼吸衰竭入住ICU的慢性神经系统疾病患者，其中ALS占14.1%。结果显示ICU死亡率为33.6%，APACHE II评分是ICU死亡的主要预测因素。出院后长期生存整体较差，死亡集中在出院后数月内，但接受家庭无创通气的患者生存情况相对更好。研究强调出院后呼吸支持和营养方案需个体化。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS等慢性神经疾病患者发生急性呼吸衰竭后的预后提供了真实世界数据，明确了ICU内死亡主要由急性生理严重度决定，而长期生存与出院后呼吸支持策略（尤其是家庭NIMV）密切相关，对ALS患者呼吸衰竭后的管理决策具有直接参考价值。

items.abstractZh: 慢性神经系统疾病（CND）患者发生肺部并发症的风险增加，常需入住ICU。本研究旨在识别发生急性呼吸衰竭（ARF）的CND患者中与ICU死亡率和长期生存相关的临床因素。这项回顾性队列研究在一家三级呼吸ICU进行，纳入既往患有CND且因ARF入住ICU的患者。采用多变量logistic回归分析ICU死亡率，采用Kaplan-Meier生存分析和Cox比例风险模型评估ICU出院后的长期生存，并通过风险函数分析进一步描述死亡时间特征。共纳入220例患者，最常见的神经系统诊断为痴呆（37.3%）、卒中（22.7%）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（14.1%）。ICU死亡率为33.6%。较高的APACHE II评分与ICU死亡率增加独立相关（每增加1分OR 1.076；95% CI 1.029-1.126；p < 0.001）。长期生存因出院后呼吸支持策略不同而显著差异，Kaplan-Meier分析显示接受家庭无创机械通气（NIMV）的患者生存模式更优（p = 0.003）。Cox回归分析中，年龄、家庭NIMV和出院时喂养方式与长期结局独立相关。生存分析显示ICU出院后最初几个月内死亡聚集，尤其在痴呆患者中。在CND患者中，急性生理严重程度是ICU死亡率的主要决定因素，而ICU出院后长期生存较差，死亡集中在出院后最初几个月。出院后呼吸支持和营养管理应根据预期临床轨迹和患者价值观进行个体化。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的真实队列数据，直接关联ALS患者急性呼吸衰竭后的ICU与长期预后管理，具有明确的ALS转化价值。

items.title: ATXN2 Spectrum Disorders: Genetic Complexity Beyond Dominant Inheritance.
items.summary: The genetic complexity of ATXN2 challenges conventional paradigms in neurodegeneration. While initially linked to autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 2, ATXN2 CAG expansions have emerged as a major risk factor for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In a recent article, Saucier et al. describe an Acadian family with a recessive inheritance pattern of ATXN2 -related disease, challenging the long-held assumption of a predominantly autosomal dominant, gain-of-function-driven mechanism. Here, we analyze how ATXN2 's inheritance mode may shift based on repeat interruptions, somatic mosaicism, and gene dosage, suggesting that loss-of-function mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis in certain contexts. We discuss implications for disease classification, genetic counseling, and therapeutic strategies, emphasizing the need for genetic stratification.
items.titleZh: ATXN2 谱系疾病：超越显性遗传的遗传复杂性
items.summaryZh: 本文评论了 ATXN2 相关疾病遗传模式的复杂性，指出除了传统的常染色体显性遗传外，还存在隐性遗传、重复中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量效应等机制，可能涉及功能丧失致病。这对 ALS 的遗传咨询和分层治疗有重要启示。
items.insight: 该评论挑战了 ATXN2 相关疾病仅由显性功能获得机制驱动的传统观点，提出功能丧失机制也可能参与，这对理解 ALS 的遗传异质性及开发针对不同遗传亚型的治疗策略至关重要。

aiRead.keyFinding: ATXN2 相关疾病可能不仅限于显性遗传，隐性遗传、重复中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量等机制可能涉及功能丧失致病。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为评论文章，未提供新的实验数据，观点基于对现有文献和个案家族的分析。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对 ATXN2 功能丧失机制的实验研究，以及遗传分层在 ALS 临床试验中的应用。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2 的遗传复杂性挑战了神经退行性疾病的传统范式。虽然最初与常染色体显性脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型相关，但 ATXN2 CAG 扩增已成为肌萎缩侧索硬化的重要风险因素。在最近的一篇文章中，Saucier 等人描述了一个具有 ATXN2 相关疾病隐性遗传模式的阿卡迪亚家族，挑战了长期以来关于主要常染色体显性、功能获得性驱动机制的假设。在此，我们分析了 ATXN2 的遗传模式如何根据重复中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量而改变，提示功能丧失机制在某些情况下有助于发病机制。我们讨论了对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略的影响，强调遗传分层的必要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该评论基于 2026 年最新发表的家族研究，直接关联 ALS 风险基因 ATXN2，并提出了遗传模式的新见解，具有高度的 ALS 相关性和新近性。

items.title: Circular RNAs in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the progressive loss of motor neurons, with most cases lacking a clear genetic basis. Emerging evidence highlights the involvement of non-coding RNAs, particularly circular RNAs (circRNAs), in disease onset and progression. Here, we investigated circRNAs implicated in ALS and related motor neuron diseases (MNDs). Here, we provide a general overview of circular RNA metabolism and cellular functions. We then present our systematic literature review that identified ALS-associated circRNAs, followed by in silico analyses of 15 circular RNA candidates that were selected based on the most compelling data regarding ALS. Our results revealed that several circular RNAs regulate ALS-related genes, such as unfolded protein response, oxidative stress, cell cycle regulation, and apoptosis. Protein-RNA interaction analysis further showed that ALS-related circRNAs can sponge 20 RNA-binding proteins. Additionally, molecular docking analysis demonstrated that ALS-associated FUS variants significantly alter its binding affinity to circular RNAs. RNA-seq data from ALS patients confirmed significant alterations in the expression of host genes of ALS-related circRNAs and hub proteins in ALS-affected CNS tissues. Collectively, our findings identify circRNAs as potential key contributors to ALS pathogenesis.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中的环状RNA
items.summaryZh: 这项研究通过系统性文献回顾和计算机模拟分析，筛选出15个与ALS相关的环状RNA候选分子。研究发现这些circRNAs参与调控ALS相关基因，涉及未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激等通路，并能海绵吸附20个RNA结合蛋白。ALS相关FUS突变会改变其与circRNAs的结合能力，患者组织RNA-seq数据也证实了相关基因表达的改变。研究提示circRNAs可能是ALS病理机制中的重要参与者。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS中非编码RNA调控网络提供了系统性证据，特别是circRNAs通过海绵吸附RNA结合蛋白和调控应激通路参与疾病机制，为未来基于circRNAs的生物标志物或治疗靶点开发提供了候选分子基础。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，其特征是运动神经元的进行性丧失，大多数病例缺乏明确的遗传基础。新出现的证据强调了非编码RNA，特别是环状RNA（circRNAs），在疾病发生和进展中的作用。在此，我们研究了与ALS及相关运动神经元疾病（MNDs）有关的circRNAs。我们首先概述了环状RNA的代谢和细胞功能，随后进行了系统性文献回顾以识别与ALS相关的circRNAs，并基于最有力的数据对15个circRNA候选分子进行了计算机模拟分析。结果显示，多个环状RNA调控ALS相关基因，涉及未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期调控和凋亡等通路。蛋白质-RNA相互作用分析进一步表明，ALS相关circRNAs可海绵吸附20个RNA结合蛋白。此外，分子对接分析显示，ALS相关的FUS变异显著改变其与circRNAs的结合亲和力。来自ALS患者的RNA-seq数据证实，在ALS受累的中枢神经系统中，ALS相关circRNAs的宿主基因及枢纽蛋白的表达发生显著改变。总之，我们的发现将circRNAs确定为ALS发病机制的潜在关键贡献者。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，结合系统文献回顾与多组学计算机模拟分析，系统揭示了circRNAs在ALS发病中的调控网络，具有明确的ALS转化研究价值。

items.title: Nuclear SOD1 links ATM-CHK2 signaling to ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SHSY-5Y SOD1 G93A cellular models of ALS.
items.summary: The activity of S-nitrosoglutathione reductase (ADH5/GSNOR) has been proposed being essential to limit oxidative stress and preserve mitochondrial quality control. Here we identify a redox-dependent ATM-CHK2-SOD1 signaling axis that drives ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SH-SY5Y cells expressing the ALS-associated SOD1 G93A mutant. ATM-CHK2 activation promotes the interaction of SOD1 with CHK2, leading to SOD1 nuclear translocation and binding to the ADH5 promoter. Pharmacological inhibition of ATM or CHK2 abolishes these effects. ADH5/GSNOR overexpression protects cells from SOD1 G93A -induced toxicity suggesting that the modulation of GSNOR activity may represent a potential strategy to restore redox homeostasis in ALS.
items.titleZh: 核SOD1将ATM-CHK2信号与ALS SHSY-5Y SOD1 G93A细胞模型中的ADH5/GSNOR转录联系起来
items.summaryZh: 这项细胞研究发现，在表达ALS相关SOD1 G93A突变的SH-SY5Y细胞中，ATM-CHK2信号通路激活后，SOD1进入细胞核并结合ADH5启动子，促进ADH5/GSNOR转录。ADH5/GSNOR过表达能减轻SOD1 G93A引起的细胞毒性。提示通过增强GSNOR活性可能有助于对抗ALS中的氧化应激。
items.insight: 该研究首次将ATM-CHK2 DNA损伤应答通路与SOD1的核功能及GSNOR转录调控联系起来，为理解SOD1突变如何影响氧化还原稳态和线粒体质量控制提供了新机制，并提示GSNOR可能是ALS的潜在治疗靶点。

aiRead.keyFinding: ATM-CHK2激活促进SOD1核转位并上调ADH5/GSNOR转录，ADH5/GSNOR过表达可减轻SOD1 G93A毒性。
aiRead.limitation: 仅使用单一细胞系（SH-SY5Y），缺乏动物模型或患者样本验证；未评估长期效应或体内可行性。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否在SOD1 G93A转基因小鼠或ALS患者样本中验证该信号轴，以及GSNOR调节剂在体内模型中的疗效。

items.abstractZh: S-亚硝基谷胱甘肽还原酶（ADH5/GSNOR）的活性被认为对于限制氧化应激和维持线粒体质量控制至关重要。本研究在表达ALS相关SOD1 G93A突变体的SH-SY5Y细胞中，鉴定出一个氧化还原依赖的ATM-CHK2-SOD1信号轴，该轴驱动ADH5/GSNOR转录。ATM-CHK2激活促进SOD1与CHK2的相互作用，导致SOD1核转位并结合到ADH5启动子上。ATM或CHK2的药理学抑制可消除这些效应。ADH5/GSNOR过表达保护细胞免受SOD1 G93A诱导的毒性，提示调节GSNOR活性可能代表一种恢复ALS中氧化还原稳态的潜在策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，揭示了SOD1在细胞核内的新功能及其与ATM-CHK2通路的交叉对话，为ALS的氧化应激机制提供了新的转化靶点。

items.title: Persistent export bias of TDP-43 under native autoregulation links insoluble accumulation to nuclear dysfunction.
items.summary: Nuclear depletion and cytoplasmic mislocalization of TDP-43 are central pathological features of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal lobar degeneration. TDP-43 protein levels are normally maintained by autoregulation through its native 3' untranslated region (3' UTR), but whether this feedback remains protective during chronic cytoplasmic bias is unclear. To address this, we engineered full-length human TDP-43 carrying an N-terminal nuclear export signal (NES) while retaining the native 3' UTR autoregulatory module. In HEK293T cells, NES insertion imposed cytoplasmic bias and promoted detergent-insoluble TDP-43 species. In differentiated SH-SY5Y cells, nuclear splicing defects and autoregulatory changes scaled with export-biased load; detergent-insoluble accumulation was already detectable within a low-load range, defined by whole-cell RIPA-soluble exogenous TDP-43 ≤ 30% of endogenous levels. Human iPSC-derived neurons showed a comparable cytoplasmic shift, discrete TDP-43-immunoreactive foci, and TDP-43-dependent splicing defects. Endogenous TARDBP depletion provided a functional rescue test: nuclear-competent WT-TDP-43-3' UTR restored TDP-43-dependent nuclear readouts, whereas NES-TDP-43-3' UTR did not. In the NES condition, weakened autorepression increased transgene-derived TARDBP transcripts, but the added output failed to expand the soluble, splice-competent pool and instead partitioned into insoluble fractions. Increasing soluble NES-TDP-43 to endogenous-equivalent levels likewise did not normalize splicing, indicating that abundance alone is insufficient when output remains export-biased. These findings support a model in which persistent export bias converts native TARDBP autoregulation into maladaptive feedback: compensatory output is uncoupled from productive nuclear recovery and diverted toward cytoplasmic insoluble/fragmented species.
items.titleZh: 天然自调控下的TDP-43持续输出偏向将不溶性积累与核功能障碍联系起来
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，当TDP-43被强制持续输出到细胞质时，其天然的自调控机制反而变成有害的：细胞试图通过增加TDP-43产量来补偿核内缺失，但新增的蛋白无法进入细胞核执行正常功能，而是聚集为不溶性沉淀，加剧病理。研究在多种细胞模型（包括人iPSC来源神经元）中验证了这一机制，提示单纯增加TDP-43表达量不足以挽救核功能，关键在于纠正其核质分布偏向。
items.insight: 该研究首次揭示TDP-43自调控在慢性胞质偏向条件下从保护性反馈转变为致病性循环，为理解ALS中TDP-43病理的不可逆进展提供了新机制，并提示治疗策略应聚焦于恢复核质运输平衡而非单纯提升蛋白水平。

items.abstractZh: TDP-43的核耗竭和胞质错误定位是肌萎缩侧索硬化症和额颞叶变性的核心病理特征。TDP-43蛋白水平通常通过其天然3'非翻译区（3' UTR）的自调控维持，但在慢性胞质偏向期间，这种反馈是否仍具有保护作用尚不清楚。为此，我们构建了携带N端核输出信号（NES）的全长人TDP-43，同时保留天然3' UTR自调控模块。在HEK293T细胞中，NES插入诱导胞质偏向并促进去污剂不溶性TDP-43物种的形成。在分化的SH-SY5Y细胞中，核剪接缺陷和自调控变化与输出偏向负荷成比例；在低负荷范围内（定义为全细胞RIPA可溶性外源TDP-43 ≤ 内源水平的30%），已可检测到去污剂不溶性积累。人iPSC来源的神经元显示出类似的胞质移位、离散的TDP-43免疫反应性病灶以及TDP-43依赖性剪接缺陷。内源TARDBP耗竭提供了功能性挽救测试：核胜任的WT-TDP-43-3' UTR恢复了TDP-43依赖性核读数，而NES-TDP-43-3' UTR则未能恢复。在NES条件下，减弱的自抑制增加了转基因来源的TARDBP转录本，但增加的输出未能扩大可溶性、剪接胜任的池，而是分配到不溶性部分。将可溶性NES-TDP-43增加到内源等效水平同样未能使剪接正常化，表明当输出仍偏向输出时，仅丰度不足。这些发现支持一个模型，即持续的输出偏向将天然TARDBP自调控转化为适应不良的反馈：补偿性输出与生产性核恢复脱钩，并转向胞质不溶性/片段化物种。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，直接针对ALS核心病理TDP-43的核质分布调控，提出了自调控失效的新模型，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: Possible Paraneoplastic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Presenting as Respiratory Failure in a Breast Cancer Patient: A Case Report.
items.summary: A 63-year-old female with metastatic breast cancer presented with acute hypercapnic respiratory failure secondary to severe diaphragmatic dysfunction and mixed upper and lower motor neuron signs. Serum onconeural and neural surface antibody panels were negative, and initial cerebrospinal fluid analysis revealed albuminocytologic dissociation. Immunotherapy with intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) produced no clinical improvement, necessitating invasive mechanical ventilation and gastrostomy. Applying the 2021 PNS-Care consensus criteria, the case fulfills criteria for possible paraneoplastic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), although coincidental sporadic disease cannot be excluded. A markedly elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) was observed, largely attributable to skeletal metastases and localized pulmonary collapse. Clinicians must maintain a high index of suspicion for motor neuron disease in cancer patients with unexplained hypoventilation.

items.titleZh: 乳腺癌患者以呼吸衰竭为首发表现的可能副肿瘤性肌萎缩侧索硬化：病例报告
items.summaryZh: 本病例报告描述了一位转移性乳腺癌患者以急性呼吸衰竭为首发表现，最终被诊断为可能的副肿瘤性ALS。患者血清抗体阴性，IVIG治疗无效，需机械通气支持。该病例提示，癌症患者出现不明原因低通气时，需考虑运动神经元病的可能。

items.abstractZh: 一名63岁转移性乳腺癌女性患者因严重膈肌功能障碍及上、下运动神经元混合体征，出现急性高碳酸血症性呼吸衰竭。血清副肿瘤性神经抗体和神经表面抗体检测均为阴性，初次脑脊液分析显示白蛋白-细胞学分离。静脉注射免疫球蛋白（IVIG）免疫治疗未见临床改善，需行有创机械通气和胃造瘘。应用2021年PNS-Care共识标准，该病例符合可能副肿瘤性肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的标准，但不能排除偶发性散发性疾病。观察到红细胞沉降率（ESR）显著升高，主要归因于骨骼转移和局部肺不张。临床医生对出现不明原因低通气的癌症患者应高度警惕运动神经元病。
items.frontierRationale: 该报告基于2021年最新PNS-Care共识标准，为副肿瘤性ALS的临床表型谱提供了新近的病例证据，有助于提高对癌症患者中运动神经元病的识别。

items.title: A standardized framework resolves ambiguity in motor neuron loss across neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary: Motor neuron (MN) loss is a hallmark of neurodegenerative disorders, yet its assessment remains variable, confounding mechanistic and therapeutic interpretation. To address this, we conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) mouse studies, revealing 60% variability in reported MN loss, for which spinal cord sampling emerged as a major contributor. Using a whole-segment approach with tissue clearing, MN tracing, and multimodal imaging, we confirmed segment-dependent differences in MN counts. Common MN markers (SMI-32, Nissl) lacked specificity, whereas choline acetyltransferase (ChAT) provided robust labeling in murine and human spinal cords. Deep learning-based whole-mount segmentation enabled unbiased MN quantification and validated manual counts. Integrating analysis with computational modeling established segment sampling as a key driver of variability and revealed degeneration patterns: widespread MN loss in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), selective MN loss in severe SMA, and preservation in mild SMA models. These findings establish a framework for reproducible MN quantification.
items.titleZh: 标准化框架消除神经退行性疾病中运动神经元丢失评估的模糊性
items.summaryZh: 该研究通过系统综述和荟萃分析发现，SMA小鼠研究中运动神经元丢失的报告存在高达60%的变异性，主要源于脊髓取样位置不同。研究者开发了全节段分析框架，结合组织透明化、ChAT标记和深度学习分割，实现了无偏倚的定量。结果显示ALS表现为广泛运动神经元丢失，而SMA的丢失模式与严重程度相关。该框架为ALS等疾病的运动神经元定量提供了标准化方法。
items.insight: 该研究直接回应了ALS领域长期存在的运动神经元定量标准化问题，其全节段分析框架和深度学习工具可提高不同实验室间结果的可比性，对ALS药物疗效评估和机制研究具有直接参考价值。

items.abstractZh: 运动神经元（MN）丢失是神经退行性疾病的标志，但其评估方法仍存在差异，干扰了机制和治疗解读。为此，我们对脊髓性肌萎缩（SMA）小鼠研究进行了系统综述和荟萃分析，发现所报告的运动神经元丢失存在60%的变异性，其中脊髓取样是主要影响因素。采用全节段方法结合组织透明化、运动神经元示踪和多模态成像，我们确认了运动神经元计数存在节段依赖性差异。常用运动神经元标志物（SMI-32、Nissl）缺乏特异性，而胆碱乙酰转移酶（ChAT）在小鼠和人类脊髓中提供了稳健的标记。基于深度学习的整体封片分割实现了无偏倚的运动神经元定量，并验证了人工计数。将分析与计算建模相结合，确定节段取样是变异性的关键驱动因素，并揭示了退化模式：肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中广泛的运动神经元丢失，重度SMA中选择性运动神经元丢失，以及轻度SMA模型中的保留。这些发现为可重复的运动神经元定量建立了框架。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，通过整合深度学习与计算建模提出标准化定量框架，直接解决ALS研究中运动神经元评估的变异性问题，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: Organ donation and brain preservation after assisted dying: case report and considerations for a potential pathway.
items.summary: Protecting life and restoring health have been at the core of the conception of medical care since antiquity, for health professionals and the public alike. Assisted dying represents a practice that appears to challenge this traditional conception. In jurisdictions where assisted dying is condoned, the question remains as to whether the practice should be medicalized or deferred to non-medical actors. Irrespective of the divisive controversy surrounding assisted dying and its medicalization per se, the practice gives rise to high-stakes ethical, legal and organizational challenges when intersecting with organ transplantation, tissue banking, and Structural Brain Preservation or cryonics. In this narrative account, we describe the contextual framework and outline our experience and operational scope for addressing them at a university hospital in Germany. Based on this description we propose a structured pathway for increasing donation and preservation options for terminal patients while retaining ethical integrity and professional accountability.
items.titleZh: 辅助死亡后的器官捐献与脑保存：病例报告及潜在路径的考量

items.abstractZh: 自古以来，保护生命和恢复健康一直是医疗保健概念的核心，对卫生专业人员和公众而言皆是如此。辅助死亡是一种似乎挑战这一传统概念的实践。在允许辅助死亡的司法管辖区，仍存在一个问题，即这种做法是否应医学化，或交由非医疗人员处理。无论围绕辅助死亡及其本身医学化存在何种分歧性争议，当这种做法与器官移植、组织库以及结构性脑保存或人体冷冻学相交时，都会引发高风险伦理、法律和组织挑战。在本叙述性报告中，我们描述了背景框架，并概述了我们在德国一所大学医院处理这些问题的经验和操作范围。基于此描述，我们提出了一条结构化路径，以在保持伦理完整性和专业问责制的同时，增加临终患者的捐献和保存选择。

items.title: Proteomic and Functional Signatures of Phenoconversion in Presymptomatic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) likely has a prolonged presymptomatic phase. Identifying blood biomarkers that predict phenoconversion is critical for early intervention. We analyzed baseline serum proteomics in 270 UK Biobank participants who later developed ALS. A prespecified 19-protein panel was evaluated in relation to time-to-diagnosis. C9orf72 risk was proxied using rs10757668 genotype. Neurofilament light rose sharply in the 2-3 years preceding diagnosis (r = -0.37, P < 0.001). Muscle-stress markers, including EDA2R and MYL3, increased earlier, up to 4-6 years before onset. Higher EDA2R levels were associated with reduced grip strength at baseline. A combined 19-protein panel plus genotype predicted phenoconversion within 3 years with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.77, outperforming neurofilament light alone. ALS exhibits a measurable molecular prodrome detectable in blood years before diagnosis. Integrated proteomic and genetic profiling may support early identification and trial enrichment strategies.
items.titleZh: 症状前肌萎缩侧索硬化症表型转化的蛋白质组学和功能特征
items.summaryZh: 这项基于英国生物银行的研究发现，ALS在确诊前数年就存在可检测的血液分子变化。除了已知的NfL在确诊前2-3年升高外，肌肉应激蛋白（如EDA2R和MYL3）在发病前4-6年即开始升高。结合19种蛋白质和基因型的模型预测3年内发病的准确率（AUC 0.77）优于单独使用NfL。
items.insight: 该研究首次在大型前瞻性队列中系统描绘了ALS症状前期的多阶段蛋白质组学演变，提示肌肉应激标志物可能比神经损伤标志物（NfL）更早出现，为理解ALS疾病起始机制和设计更早的干预窗口提供了重要依据。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）可能有一个漫长的症状前期。识别能够预测表型转化的血液生物标志物对于早期干预至关重要。我们分析了270名后来发展为ALS的英国生物银行参与者的基线血清蛋白质组学。评估了一个预先指定的19种蛋白质组合与确诊时间的关系。C9orf72风险使用rs10757668基因型作为代理指标。神经丝轻链（NfL）在确诊前2-3年急剧升高（r = -0.37, P < 0.001）。肌肉应激标志物，包括EDA2R和MYL3，升高得更早，在发病前4-6年即可检测到。较高的EDA2R水平与基线时握力降低相关。19种蛋白质组合加上基因型在3年内预测表型转化的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.77，优于单独使用神经丝轻链。ALS表现出一个可测量的分子前驱期，可在确诊前数年于血液中检测到。整合蛋白质组学和遗传学特征可能有助于早期识别和试验富集策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用UK Biobank的大规模前瞻性数据，新近揭示了ALS症状前期长达4-6年的可测量分子阶段，并提出了优于NfL的早期预测组合，具有直接的转化价值。

items.title: Whole-exome sequencing reveals a novel frameshift and a recurrent nonsense SPG11 variant causing rare familial amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 5 in two consanguineous Pakistani families.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative disease that affects both upper and lower motor neurons, disturbing communication between the brain and muscles. So far, few reports have been published for the SPG11-associated ALS, and this is the first documented case from Pakistan. METHODS: We report a rare subtype of ALS with an autosomal recessive mode of inheritance with juvenile onset before 25 years of age in the five affected individuals from two unrelated families. Whole-exome sequencing was performed to identify disease-causing variants, and selected variants were further prioritized based on predicted pathogenicity and similarity to clinical phenotypes. Two homozygous variants within the SPG11 gene were identified as pathogenic according to the ACMG and ClinGen Sequence Variant Interpretation (SVI) Working Group recommendations: a novel truncation (NM_025137.4:c.6738dup, p.Glu2247Ter) variant as validated by Sanger sequencing and a recurrent nonsense (NM_025137.4: c.782C>A, p.Ser261Ter) variant (rs765477482) previously reported in a family affected with autosomal recessive hereditary spastic paraplegia (ARHSP). In silico prediction tools further confirmed their pathogenicity. Five patients with juvenile-onset ALS born to consanguineous parents were found to have homozygous SPG11 gene variants. Our findings describe the overlapping phenotypes ofSPG11-related autosomal recessive juvenile ALS and ARHSP, suggesting that these disorders show a clear overlapping phenotype with common genetic defects. In clinical practice, it is challenging to distinguish between these two disorders. Additional Mendelian cases should be included to clarify further and investigate whether these represent two diverse diseases caused by variants in a single gene.
items.titleZh: 全外显子测序在两个近亲巴基斯坦家系中发现导致罕见家族性肌萎缩侧索硬化症5型的新型移码和复发性无义SPG11变异
items.summaryZh: 这项研究首次在巴基斯坦近亲家系中报道了SPG11基因变异导致的青少年型ALS（ALS5型）。研究者通过全外显子测序在两个家系中发现了SPG11基因的纯合致病变异，包括一个新移码变异和一个已知无义变异。患者均在25岁前发病，表现出与遗传性痉挛性截瘫（ARHSP）重叠的临床特征。该发现强调了SPG11相关ALS与ARHSP在遗传和临床上的连续性，提示临床鉴别诊断的困难。
items.insight: 该研究为SPG11基因在ALS中的致病作用提供了新的种族和地理证据，并进一步支持SPG11相关疾病谱系的概念，即同一基因变异可导致从纯运动神经元病（ALS）到痉挛性截瘫的连续表型，这对ALS的遗传咨询和分子诊断具有重要意义。

aiRead.limitation: 样本量小（仅两个家系5例患者），缺乏功能实验验证，且未进行长期随访以全面描述临床谱。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种影响上、下运动神经元的神经退行性疾病，干扰大脑与肌肉之间的通讯。迄今为止，关于SPG11相关ALS的报道很少，这是巴基斯坦首例记录在案。方法：我们报告了一种罕见的ALS亚型，呈常染色体隐性遗传，在两个无关家系的5名受影响个体中于25岁前青少年期发病。进行全外显子测序以识别致病变异，并根据预测的致病性和与临床表型的相似性对选定变异进行优先排序。根据ACMG和ClinGen序列变异解读（SVI）工作组建议，SPG11基因内的两个纯合变异被确定为致病性：一个经Sanger测序验证的新型截短变异（NM_025137.4:c.6738dup, p.Glu2247Ter）和一个先前在常染色体隐性遗传性痉挛性截瘫（ARHSP）家系中报道的复发性无义变异（NM_025137.4:c.782C>A, p.Ser261Ter）（rs765477482）。计算机预测工具进一步证实了其致病性。5名出生于近亲父母的青少年期ALS患者被发现携带纯合SPG11基因变异。我们的发现描述了SPG11相关常染色体隐性青少年ALS和ARHSP的重叠表型，提示这些疾病表现出明显的表型重叠和共同的遗传缺陷。在临床实践中，区分这两种疾病具有挑战性。应纳入更多孟德尔病例以进一步阐明并研究这些是否代表由单个基因变异引起的两种不同疾病。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究报道了巴基斯坦首例SPG11相关ALS，并发现新变异，扩展了ALS5型的突变谱和人群分布，具有新近性和遗传学转化价值。

items.title: Seeds from ALS patients homozygous for the SOD1 D90A mutation transmit two types of SOD1 aggregation and motor neuron disease.
items.summary: Mutations in superoxide dismutase-1 (SOD1) are a common cause of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Inheritance is as a rule dominant, but in carriers of the most prevalent mutation, D90A, disease primarily develops in homozygotes. Increasing evidence suggests that prion-like propagation of SOD1 aggregation is the central pathogenic mechanism. Two structurally different strains of aggregates have been found to arise in human SOD1 (hSOD1) transgenic (Tg) mouse models of ALS. Strain A is formed by most mutants including hSOD1 G85R and homozygous hSOD1 WT Tg mice, whereas homozygous hSOD1 D90A Tg mice form a distinct strain B, but also A. Inoculation of strain A and B seed preparations from Tg mice into lumbar spinal cord of adult hSOD1 G85R mice induced templated spreading hSOD1 aggregation and premature ALS-like disease. Seeds from an ALS patient carrying the hSOD1 G127X truncation mutation likewise transmitted strain A aggregation and disease. In the present study, we investigated whether seeds prepared from spinal ventral horns from six patients homozygous for the hSOD1 D90A mutation could transmit aggregation and disease to adult hSOD1 G85R Tg mice. Despite the extensive degeneration and loss of motor neurons in the long-lived D90A patients, two of the seeds significantly shortened the survival of the Tg mice, one transmitting A and the other B-pattern hSOD1 aggregation. Nine different preparations from four human controls lacked effects. The results demonstrate that two distinct aggregate strains can arise and propagate in homozygous hSOD1 D90A ALS patients, further supporting the hypothesis that prion-like transmission of hSOD1 aggregation is the primary pathogenic mechanism in SOD1-linked ALS.
items.titleZh: 来自SOD1 D90A纯合突变ALS患者的种子可传播两种类型的SOD1聚集和运动神经元疾病
items.summaryZh: 这项研究使用来自6名SOD1 D90A纯合突变ALS患者的脊髓组织制备种子，将其接种到hSOD1 G85R转基因小鼠中。结果显示，其中2名患者的种子能显著缩短小鼠生存期，分别诱导A型和B型两种不同构象的SOD1蛋白聚集，而4名对照者的9种制剂均无效应。这表明人类患者体内确实存在两种不同的SOD1聚集株，支持SOD1聚集通过类朊病毒机制传播的假说。
items.insight: 该研究首次直接证明人类SOD1 D90A纯合突变患者体内存在两种可传播的SOD1聚集株，为SOD1-ALS的朊病毒样传播假说提供了来自人类样本的关键证据，对理解疾病异质性和开发靶向聚集传播的治疗策略具有重要意义。

aiRead.studyType: 临床样本的动物传播实验（观察性临床研究结合转基因小鼠模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: 来自SOD1 D90A纯合突变ALS患者的脊髓种子可传播两种不同构象的SOD1聚集（A型和B型），并缩短hSOD1 G85R转基因小鼠的生存期。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量小（6名患者），且只有2名患者的种子产生效应；研究使用转基因小鼠模型，不能完全等同于人类疾病过程。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究应关注不同聚集株在患者中的临床相关性（如发病年龄、病程、受累区域差异），以及开发能区分A型和B型聚集株的生物标志物或靶向特定聚集株的治疗干预。

items.abstractZh: 超氧化物歧化酶-1（SOD1）突变是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的常见病因。遗传通常为显性，但在最常见的D90A突变携带者中，疾病主要发生在纯合子中。越来越多的证据表明，SOD1聚集的类朊病毒样传播是核心致病机制。在人类SOD1（hSOD1）转基因（Tg）ALS小鼠模型中发现了两种结构不同的聚集株。A株由大多数突变体形成，包括hSOD1 G85R和纯合hSOD1 WT Tg小鼠，而纯合hSOD1 D90A Tg小鼠形成独特的B株，但也形成A株。将来自Tg小鼠的A株和B株种子制剂接种到成年hSOD1 G85R小鼠的腰椎脊髓中，诱导了模板化传播的hSOD1聚集和早发性ALS样疾病。携带hSOD1 G127X截短突变ALS患者的种子同样传播了A株聚集和疾病。在本研究中，我们调查了来自六名hSOD1 D90A纯合突变患者脊髓腹角制备的种子是否能将聚集和疾病传播给成年hSOD1 G85R Tg小鼠。尽管长寿的D90A患者运动神经元广泛变性和丢失，其中两种种子显著缩短了Tg小鼠的生存期，一种传播A型，另一种传播B型hSOD1聚集。来自四名人类对照的九种不同制剂没有效果。结果表明，两种不同的聚集株可以在纯合hSOD1 D90A ALS患者中产生和传播，进一步支持hSOD1聚集的类朊病毒样传播是SOD1相关ALS主要致病机制的假说。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，首次利用人类SOD1 D90A纯合突变患者组织直接验证了两种聚集株的跨物种传播能力，为SOD1-ALS的朊病毒样机制提供了关键的转化证据。

items.title: Mitophagy in neuronal health and disease: from mechanisms to neurodegeneration.
items.summary: Regulation of mitochondrial health is critical for maintaining cellular homeostasis in the nervous system. Damaged mitochondria can have detrimental effects on neuronal health and are thought to be key contributors to the progression of neurodegenerative disorders including Parkinson's disease and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. To mitigate this damage, multiple quality control mechanisms have evolved to eliminate aged or damaged mitochondria. One such quality control process is autophagy, a process that involves turnover of mitochondria at presynaptic sites and the axon terminal under basal conditions. This highly conserved mechanism sequesters mitochondria from the cytosol within autophagosomes followed by degradation upon fusion with a lysosome. Acute mitochondrial damage activates a selective form of autophagy called mitophagy that involves receptor-mediated engulfment and degradation of the damaged organelle. Multiple mechanisms have been shown to drive efficient mitophagy in neurons and glia, including PTEN induced kinase 1 (PINK1)/Parkin-dependent mitophagy and receptor-mediated mitophagy. Genetic, pathological, and experimental evidence all implicate defects in the removal of damaged mitochondria in the onset or progression of neurodegenerative disease. Both the initiation of PINK1/Parkin-dependent mitophagy and deficits in the removal of damaged mitochondria are linked to activation of neuroinflammatory pathways, including NF-κB and cyclic GMP-AMP synthase-stimulator of interferon genes (cGAS-STING) signaling. In this Review, we discuss the molecular pathways governing mitophagy in neurons and glial cells and how deficits in these pathways may lead to neurodegeneration. We also highlight emerging therapeutic strategies aimed at restoring mitophagy to preserve neuronal homeostasis and function.
items.titleZh: 神经元健康与疾病中的线粒体自噬：从机制到神经退行性变
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了线粒体自噬在神经元和胶质细胞中的分子机制，并指出线粒体清除缺陷与ALS等神经退行性疾病密切相关。文章强调PINK1/Parkin依赖性和受体介导的线粒体自噬通路，并讨论了神经炎症（如cGAS-STING）与线粒体自噬的交叉作用。最后，作者提出恢复线粒体自噬可能成为ALS等疾病的潜在治疗策略。
items.insight: 该综述系统梳理了线粒体自噬在ALS发病中的核心作用，并指出线粒体自噬缺陷与神经炎症通路的关联，为ALS研究者提供了从线粒体质量控制角度探索治疗靶点的新思路。

aiRead.keyFinding: 线粒体自噬缺陷（特别是PINK1/Parkin通路）与神经炎症（NF-κB和cGAS-STING）相互作用，促进ALS等疾病进展；恢复线粒体自噬是潜在治疗策略。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始实验数据，且主要基于已有研究，可能缺乏对特定ALS亚型的直接验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对PINK1/Parkin或受体介导线粒体自噬的小分子激活剂在ALS动物模型中的临床试验结果，以及cGAS-STING通路抑制剂对线粒体自噬的影响。

items.abstractZh: 线粒体健康的调控对于维持神经系统的细胞稳态至关重要。受损的线粒体可对神经元健康产生不利影响，并被认为是帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化等神经退行性疾病进展的关键因素。为减轻这种损伤，机体进化出多种质量控制机制以清除老化或受损的线粒体。其中一种质量控制过程是自噬，即在基础条件下，线粒体在突触前位点和轴突末端的周转。这一高度保守的机制将线粒体从胞质中隔离到自噬体内，随后在与溶酶体融合后被降解。急性线粒体损伤会激活一种称为线粒体自噬的选择性自噬形式，涉及受体介导的受损细胞器的吞噬和降解。多种机制已被证明可驱动神经元和胶质细胞中的有效线粒体自噬，包括PTEN诱导激酶1（PINK1）/Parkin依赖性线粒体自噬和受体介导的线粒体自噬。遗传、病理和实验证据均表明，受损线粒体清除缺陷与神经退行性疾病的发生或进展有关。PINK1/Parkin依赖性线粒体自噬的启动以及受损线粒体清除的缺陷均与神经炎症通路的激活相关，包括NF-κB和环状GMP-AMP合酶-干扰素基因刺激因子（cGAS-STING）信号通路。在本综述中，我们讨论了神经元和胶质细胞中调控线粒体自噬的分子通路，以及这些通路的缺陷如何导致神经退行性变。我们还重点介绍了旨在恢复线粒体自噬以维持神经元稳态和功能的新兴治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新线粒体自噬机制研究，并直接关联ALS等神经退行性疾病的转化治疗策略，具有高度ALS相关性和新近性。

items.title: Cofilin 1 Is an Extracellular Vesicle-Associated Plasma Biomarker of Parkinson's Disease in Humans.
items.summary: Parkinson's disease (PD) lacks reliable, minimally invasive biomarkers for diagnosis. This study aimed to identify and validate PD-specific plasma extracellular vesicle (EV)-associated proteins. Plasma EVs were isolated by ultracentrifugation and characterized. Proteomic profiling of total plasma EVs from PD patients and healthy controls was performed, and a candidate protein identified after analysis was validated by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. Diagnostic accuracy was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic and precision-recall curve analysis. Disease specificity was examined in progressive supranuclear palsy and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Histochemical and immunofluorescence analyses were conducted in human and mouse PD brain tissue. Proteomic analysis identified distinct PD-specific EV proteins, including cofilin 1 (CFL1), which was significantly enriched in EVs isolated from PD. EV-CFL1 levels were significantly elevated in PD compared with healthy controls (p < 0.0001). Receiver operating characteristic analysis showed strong diagnostic performance for EV-CFL1 (area under the curve 0.87). Also, EV CFL1 levels could distinguish PD from progressive supranuclear palsy patients (area under the curve 0.914). CFL1 was enriched in L1 cell adhesion molecule-positive EVs, indicating a possible neuronal origin. CFL1 was detected in both human and mouse PD brain sections. Importantly, EV-CFL1 levels were independent of age, disease stage, and motor severity. EV-associated CFL1 represents a PD-specific, blood-based marker with strong diagnostic accuracy and can distinguish PD from atypical parkinsonism. The presence of CFL1 was confirmed in human and mouse PD brain tissue, and its accumulation in PD brain suggests a possible role in disease pathogenesis. ANN NEUROL 2026.
items.titleZh: Cofilin 1 是人类帕金森病中一种与细胞外囊泡相关的血浆生物标志物
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，帕金森病患者血液中由细胞外囊泡携带的 cofilin 1 (CFL1) 蛋白水平显著升高，能够以较高准确性区分帕金森病与健康对照及其他帕金森综合征（如进行性核上性麻痹）。该标志物水平不受患者年龄、病程或运动症状严重程度影响，提示其可能作为疾病诊断的独立指标。
items.insight: 该研究为 ALS 研究提供了重要参照：它展示了一种通过血浆细胞外囊泡发现并验证神经退行性疾病特异性蛋白标志物的完整策略。鉴于 ALS 同样缺乏可靠的体液诊断标志物，这种从 EVs 蛋白质组学入手、结合疾病特异性验证（包括与 ALS 对照比较）的方法学路径，可直接借鉴用于 ALS 生物标志物的开发。

aiRead.keyFinding: 帕金森病患者血浆细胞外囊泡中的 CFL1 蛋白水平显著升高，具有较高的诊断准确性（AUC 0.87），并能区分 PD 与进行性核上性麻痹（AUC 0.914）。

items.abstractZh: 帕金森病（PD）缺乏可靠、微创的诊断生物标志物。本研究旨在识别并验证 PD 特异性的血浆细胞外囊泡（EV）相关蛋白。通过超速离心分离血浆 EVs 并对其进行表征。对 PD 患者和健康对照者的总血浆 EVs 进行了蛋白质组学分析，分析后确定的一种候选蛋白通过酶联免疫吸附测定进行了验证。使用受试者工作特征曲线和精确率-召回率曲线分析评估诊断准确性。在进行性核上性麻痹和肌萎缩侧索硬化中检查了疾病特异性。在人和小鼠 PD 脑组织中进行了组织化学和免疫荧光分析。蛋白质组学分析确定了独特的 PD 特异性 EV 蛋白，包括 cofilin 1 (CFL1)，其在 PD 分离的 EVs 中显著富集。与健康对照相比，PD 中的 EV-CFL1 水平显著升高（p < 0.0001）。受试者工作特征分析显示 EV-CFL1 具有强大的诊断性能（曲线下面积 0.87）。此外，EV CFL1 水平可将 PD 与进行性核上性麻痹患者区分开来（曲线下面积 0.914）。CFL1 在 L1 细胞粘附分子阳性的 EVs 中富集，表明其可能源于神经元。在人和小鼠 PD 脑切片中均检测到 CFL1。重要的是，EV-CFL1 水平与年龄、疾病分期和运动严重程度无关。EV 相关的 CFL1 代表了一种 PD 特异性的、基于血液的标记物，具有强大的诊断准确性，并可将 PD 与非典型帕金森综合征区分开来。CFL1 在人和小鼠 PD 脑组织中的存在得到证实，其在 PD 脑中的积累提示其在疾病发病机制中可能发挥作用。ANN NEUROL 2026。

items.title: CSF Tau and Amyloid Biomarkers in Cognitive Impairment Across the ALS-FTD Spectrum: A Systematic Narrative Review and Evidence Map.
items.summary: Cognitive impairment is an important non-motor manifestation of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), particularly across the ALS-frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD) spectrum. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) tau and amyloid biomarkers may reflect nonspecific neurodegenerative injury, concomitant Alzheimer disease (AD) pathology, or distinct cognitive phenotypes. However, available evidence remains limited, fragmented, and methodologically heterogeneous. This systematic narrative review and semi-quantitative evidence map was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 recommendations. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar were searched from database inception through May 2026. Eligible observational studies reported cognition-specific associations between CSF tau, amyloid, or related neurodegenerative biomarkers and cognitive outcomes in ALS-spectrum populations. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted quantitative effect estimates, and assessed risk of bias using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale. Cross-study consistency was summarized using an exploratory semi-quantitative evidence-coding framework. Four observational studies comprising 638 ALS-spectrum participants fulfilled the eligibility criteria. Total tau and p-tau181 showed the most reproducible associations with cognition. Total tau correlated with ECAS total (r = -0.398, P < 0.001) and ALS-specific cognition (r = -0.403, P < 0.001), while adjusted multicenter analyses demonstrated associations between p-tau181 and ECAS total (β = -0.03, p = 0.006) and memory performance (β = -0.04, p = 0.003). Both biomarkers received ++ evidence-map coding. Amyloid findings were more heterogeneous; lower Aβ42/Aβ40 was associated with poorer memory performance (β = 0.20, p = 0.044), but continuous amyloid-cognition associations were not consistently replicated across cohorts (± evidence). Broader CSF protein-ratio findings remained exploratory. Clinical, cognitive, assay, and analytical heterogeneity precluded meta-analysis. The available evidence, although limited and heterogeneous, suggests that total tau may primarily reflect broader neurodegenerative injury, whereas p-tau181 and Aβ42/Aβ40 may be more informative for selected cognitive phenotypes or possible AD co-pathology. These biomarkers should remain research tools until larger, standardized, longitudinal multicenter studies establish their pathological specificity, predictive value, and clinical utility.

items.abstractZh: 认知障碍是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）重要的非运动表现，尤其在ALS-额颞叶痴呆（ALS-FTD）谱系中。脑脊液（CSF）tau和淀粉样蛋白生物标志物可能反映非特异性神经退行性损伤、合并阿尔茨海默病（AD）病理或不同的认知表型。然而，现有证据仍然有限、零散且方法学上异质性高。本系统性叙述性综述和半定量证据图谱按照PRISMA 2020建议进行。检索了PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar，时间从数据库建库至2026年5月。符合条件的观察性研究报告了ALS谱系人群中CSF tau、淀粉样蛋白或相关神经退行性生物标志物与认知结局之间的认知特异性关联。两名评审员独立筛选研究、提取定量效应估计值，并使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估偏倚风险。使用探索性半定量证据编码框架总结了研究间的一致性。共4项观察性研究（638名ALS谱系参与者）符合纳入标准。总tau和p-tau181与认知的关联最具可重复性。总tau与ECAS总分（r = -0.398, P < 0.001）和ALS特异性认知（r = -0.403, P < 0.001）相关，而调整后的多中心分析显示p-tau181与ECAS总分（β = -0.03, p = 0.006）和记忆表现（β = -0.04, p = 0.003）存在关联。两种生物标志物均获得++证据图谱编码。淀粉样蛋白结果异质性更大；较低的Aβ42/Aβ40与较差的记忆表现相关（β = 0.20, p = 0.044），但连续的淀粉样蛋白-认知关联在各队列中未得到一致重复（±证据）。更广泛的CSF蛋白比值发现仍处于探索阶段。临床、认知、检测和分析异质性排除了荟萃分析的可能性。现有证据虽然有限且异质，但提示总tau可能主要反映更广泛的神经退行性损伤，而p-tau181和Aβ42/Aβ40可能对特定认知表型或可能的AD共病理更具信息价值。在更大规模、标准化、纵向多中心研究确定其病理特异性、预测价值和临床实用性之前，这些生物标志物应仅作为研究工具。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述基于截至2026年5月的文献检索，首次以半定量证据图谱形式系统梳理了ALS-FTD谱系中CSF tau/淀粉样生物标志物与认知表型的关联，具有直接的ALS转化研究价值。
